plugins.name: hook-tap
plugins.description: Shows the current hook stage in the status line and appends each event's input to log.jsonl, for learning how hooks fire.

plugins.name: open-knowledge-plugin
plugins.description: Author, maintain, backfill, validate, visualize and serve (MCP) Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles: portable markdown knowledge for humans and agents. Vendored as a git submodule from the skogai2 fork, as an example of that plugin-source pattern.
